name: Linear
whatYouLose: Deep GitHub, Slack and product workflow integrations
Roadmaps, cycles and reporting refined for large teams
prompt: Create a fast issue tracker for a product team. Include teams, projects, issues, priorities, labels, assignees, comments, attachments, cycles, a backlog, command palette, keyboard shortcuts, saved filters, GitHub issue linking and activity history. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript and SQLite. Server-render every list, use small progressive-enhancement scripts, and add optimistic updates with rollback on failure.
notes: The data model is ordinary. Linear’s advantage is thousands of tiny interaction decisions and integration reliability.
